Karna.note: Kunti's firstborn, begotten by Surya the sun-god before her marriage; set adrift on the river and raised by the charioteer Adhiratha, so his birth lineage stayed unknown even to him. Half-brother of the Pandavas, he fought and died for Duryodhana, learning his kin too late.

Adhiratha.note: A charioteer (suta) of Hastinapura who drew the infant Karna from the river and raised him as his own.

Radha.note: Wife of Adhiratha; foster-mother of Karna, whence his name Radheya.

people.Vrishasena: Son of Karna; a warrior slain by Arjuna at Kurukshetra.
people.Vrishaketu: Youngest son of Karna and the only one to outlive the war; taken in and cherished by the Pandavas once his parentage was known.

Surya.name: Surya Deva
Surya.note: The deva of the sun; an Aditya, son of the devi Aditi and the rishi Kashyap. Father of Karna, whom Kunti bore before her marriage by invoking Surya with a boon she wished to test.
